profile.headline: Senior software engineer at The Home Depot
profile.summary: Currently a Senior Software Engineer  at The Home Depot. With my years of experience, I am becoming a full stack developer, working with languages of javascript, java, and continuous integration platforms. I take pride in the work I do to provide superior code quality.  Along with continuous learning as a developer, I try my best to learn new tech stacks along with providing good shareholder value to the company.

positions.title: Retail Media Software Engineer ||
positions.description:
As a Software Engineer II, I’ve led and contributed to several high-impact initiatives across recommendation systems, ad tech, and user experience enhancements. My focus has been on driving measurable outcomes through data-driven development, scalable architecture, and a strong culture of mentorship and collaboration.

Key Achievements:

Led A/B Testing Integration for recommendation models, enabling accurate performance comparisons via BigQuery-backed data pipelines.

Integrated Context-Free Strategies for product recommendations using different recommendation models, significantly improving relevance and user engagement on pages.

Enhanced Personalization by launching location-based configurable carousel titles, resulting in improved user satisfaction and engagement.

Delivered Ad Placement Carousels with end-to-end ownership, including robust metrics tracking (20%+ visibility improvement), edge case handling, and performance optimization.

Drove Mentorship & Team Growth, mentoring junior developers, leading knowledge-sharing sessions, and fostering a collaborative engineering culture.

Owned Story and Epic Planning for key features like carousels, resolving critical dependencies and aligning cross-functional teams.

Invested in Continuous Learning through mentorship, self-development, and active participation in technical discussions and community forums.

positions.title: Marketing Technology Software Engineer II
positions.description:
I am a seasoned professional with a proven track record of successfully enhancing customer engagement and increasing revenue by 10% and 1%, respectively, on Contentful pages. My expertise centers around optimizing content performance and improving decision-making visibility through vigilant monitoring of key metrics such as Click Through Rate (CTR) and Revenue per visit on implemented pages. This approach allows for a meticulous assessment of progress towards predefined organizational goals.

In my capacity as a mentor, I possess the ability to guide and educate individuals with a burgeoning interest in technology, facilitating their growth within the field. During the summer, I delivered fundamental coaching, constructive feedback, and valuable guidance to interns, aligning their objectives with organizational goals to enhance overall performance.

Throughout my previous roles, I demonstrated proficiency in creating dynamic content models for homedepot.com and internal tools, fostering increased user engagement within the Contentful application. Additionally, I conceptualized and implemented a FrontEnd UI designed to showcase alterations in Contentful, introducing feature enhancements such as request access, guides, and fundamental training materials. Furthermore, I innovatively instituted Github actions to streamline the seamless migration of new, edited, and deleted content models, thereby eliminating developer toil.

positions.title: Chief Executive Officer
positions.description:
Vital Hospitality Investment Group  is comprised of 20+ years of hotel development, investments, asset management of budget to upper-midscale hotel franchise products, and FF&E  procurement

The firm's symbolic name was built on the relationship we built over the years with hotel franchises, creditable investors FF&E vendors, and debt lenders for property development, acquisition, and management. 

At Vital Hospitality, our goal is to provide professional full-service management solutions to investors and owners by scientifically improving the growth of investment while offering an excellent and unique customer experience.
